sentences.en: The new style seems to have caught on this year.
sentences.zh: 今年这种新风格似乎流行起来了。

sentences.en: That coat is just the style I've been looking for.
sentences.zh: 那件外套正是我一直在找的款式。

sentences.en: Fashions of thirty years ago have come back in style.
sentences.zh: 三十年前的时尚又回来了，正流行起来。

phrases.zh: 我的风格；我喜欢的方式

senses.zh: 设计式样；用刻刀作装饰画
